ledger.claim: The whole of this dispute is the SGD 14.90 platform fare, nothing more. The rider's own in-app message on EV-CHAT-00711 at 08:33:40 confines the review to 'the 14.90' platform fare, and her claim text formally contests only that fare rather than the SGD 500 or the SGD 1,800 demanded in the chat. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling must be read off the filing party and the present payment state: EV-FARE-00711 shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so a ruling that leaves the charge in place leaves the rider carrying it, whereas ESCALATE holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it. The rider's objective in this forum is therefore to prevent the 14.90 being collected on a record that cannot support it.

EV-TRIP-00711 records the dropoff as amended after booking: dropoff_amended_at is 2026-09-24T08:26:40 and the amended destination differs from the original Central Gardens destination, yet amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null. POL-RD-05 provides in terms that where an amendment timestamp is present but the amended optimum is null, the re-quote is missing from the record, the clause cannot be run, and POL-RD-10(5) applies, and that the tribunal must not derive a substitute figure. POL-RD-10(5) is a mandatory escalation trigger: no final ruling issues, the case goes to a human reviewer, and under POL-GEN-03 the disputed SGD 14.90 is held rather than collected.

The derived deviation block on EV-GPS-00711 reports 'no deviation' only because derived.deviation.optimal_distance_km is 11 km while the trace is 5.91 km. That 11 km optimum is the booked route to the destination the rider never reached; the trip as run ended at the amended dropoff. POL-RD-05 requires the POL-RD-01 comparison to be re-run against the optimal route between the amended endpoints, and forbids the tribunal deriving that figure when the stored amended optimum is absent. The 'no deviation' result therefore cannot settle the fare, and the missing re-quote - not any finding for the driver - is the reason.

The driver's only explanation of the trip is an external cause - a breakdown - and he cites no artifact for it. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00711-01, is MISSING: its admissibility status is MISSING, the issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and it carries no payload, and its absence is itself citable. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else; with no advisory covering the trip window that comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable on the record, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Nothing in the bundle explains the endpoint change or justifies the charge as it stands.

The driver's account cannot be checked against anything but his own word. His counterparty statement says the private payment 'was voluntary', yet his own messages on EV-CHAT-00711 read 'Send 500 first then you go' at 08:27:00, mid-trip, and 'Repair 1800 you pay' at 08:40:20. That is mutually contradictory party evidence about the money movements surrounding this trip, with no artifact able to break the tie - the condition POL-RD-10(7) describes - and it is a further reason the disputed platform fare cannot be finally ruled on the present record.

The rider does not stretch the arithmetic. EV-FARE-00711 is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip with quoted_fare_sgd 14.90 and charged_total 14.90, so POL-RD-11 shuts off the distance-and-time route however the trip is characterised, and the rider's remedies are confined to POL-RD-11(a) - the excess of charged_total over the quoted fare plus properly chargeable pass-throughs - and to POL-RD-11(b) corrections under POL-RD-09. On this fare both come to nothing: the ERP lines are empty, no gantry is unmatched and the airport surcharge is 0.00. The rider's protection is therefore not a recomputation but the hold that escalation gives, and the missing amended re-quote is what makes that hold the correct outcome.

POL-RD-01 fixes the governing measurement for this category: the trace figure, not the rounded convenience copy on the trip record. EV-GPS-00711 records trace_distance_km of 5.91 km against a booked optimal of 11.0 km on EV-TRIP-00711, so the excess is negative (5.91 - 11.0 = -5.09 km), and the trace's own derived block reads status 'no deviation'. Neither establishment test can pass on a negative excess: -46.3% is not greater than 20% of the optimal, and -5.09 km is not greater than 0.8 km. POL-RD-01 says in terms that if either test fails no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The trace the no-deviation finding rests on is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. EV-GPS-00711 reports coverage_pct 100.0, point_count 151 at a 10 s sample interval against a 10 s expected interval, gaps [] and max_gap_sec 0.0. There is no gap of more than 90 seconds between consecutive fixes, no straight-line jump of more than 500 m, and no sustained sampling interval above 30 seconds. The finding therefore rests on a complete artifact, and neither POL-RD-07's independent-corroboration requirement nor the POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired trace. Limb (a) is satisfied - TRP-00711 matches across EV-TRIP-00711, EV-GPS-00711 and EV-FARE-00711 - but limb (b) fails outright: the driver finished 5.09 km short of the optimal, not over it. The rider has cited no measured figure that clears the threshold, so the burden never shifts and the driver is called on to answer nothing.

Even if an excess had been shown, EV-FARE-00711 carries fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 14.90 and charged_total 14.90. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, a detour costs the rider nothing on those lines, and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess; the rider's remedies are limited to (a) any amount by which charged_total exceeds the quote plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09, and (b) a POL-RD-09 pass-through correction. The money block derived on EV-FARE-00711 publishes charged_over_quote 0.00 and pol_rd_11_remedy 0.00: there is nothing to refund on this limb.

The pass-through and billing-integrity audit under POL-RD-09 comes up empty on this trip. EV-FARE-00711 lists erp_gantries as [], tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00 and waiting_time_fee 0.00, and its properly_chargeable block totals 0.00; no off-route and no phantom line is itemised. There is accordingly no standalone pass-through correction and no billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4) for the rider to collect, and the only remedy POL-RD-11 leaves open is closed.

The outcome for a claim with no excess and no refundable line is NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands, specifically fare_breakdown.payment_status and fare_breakdown.refund_issued_sgd are left as they are. EV-FARE-00711 carries payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and this is a rider-filed dispute, so leaving the state standing leaves the SGD 14.90 platform fare charged and the driver whole.

I disclose that the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00711-01, is MISSING: status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload. The driver's counterparty statement refers to a breakdown but names no advisory evidence ID, and under POL-RD-13 an external-cause assertion that cites no artifact cannot be an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable and the gap in the bundle is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger. In any event no excess is established anywhere in the record, so no exculpatory clause needs to be invoked to decide this case.

POL-RD-06 is not engaged. It is triggered only where POL-RD-01 records a MATERIAL deviation, and here the excess is negative, so no material deviation exists. Were the profile consulted anyway, the only fields citable for this test show a clean record: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 250, far below the 3-flag and 5%-of-40-trips pattern thresholds, so no pattern can be established and no remedy uplift under POL-RD-06(b) or conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) arises. The lifetime counters on the same profile are context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be substituted for those two fields.

The record shows a post-booking endpoint amendment on EV-TRIP-00711 (dropoff_amended_at 2026-09-24T08:26:40), consistent with the driver's counterparty statement that the endpoint was changed to the stopping place. A changed endpoint is not a detour, and on this record it cannot enlarge the rider's case: the only measured distance comparison available is the governing trace figure of 5.91 km (EV-GPS-00711) against the booked optimal of 11.0 km (EV-TRIP-00711), which is negative. The POL-RD-01 tests therefore fail and the POL-RD-08 burden is not met; the rider, who bears that burden, has cited no measured excess, amended or unamended, that clears the threshold.

EV-CHAT-00711 holds three messages and none of them identifies a route, a road or a waypoint - every waypoint_hint is null. The rider's only reference to the platform fare is MSG-00711-002 asking that the SGD 14.90 fare be reviewed; the exchanges about private money concern payments outside the fare ledger, and the rider's own filing states the SGD 500 is not contested here. Nothing in the chat log evidences a deviation, and an assertion citing no evidence ID carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you should read this together. This case does not end in a money order for either side. It is escalated to a human reviewer under POL-RD-10(5), and the SGD 14.90 platform fare is HELD — not collected and not refunded.

WHY THE CASE ESCALATES. EV-TRIP-00711 shows the dropoff was amended after booking: dropoff_amended_at is 2026-09-24T08:26:40, mid-trip (the trip ran 08:18:40 to 08:43:40), and the destination changed from the original Central Gardens point to the Canal View destination. POL-RD-05 requires the POL-RD-01 comparison to be re-run against the optimal route between the AMENDED endpoints, and it takes that figure from trip_record.amended_optimal_distance_km. That field is null, and amended_optimal_duration_min is null too. POL-RD-05 says in terms that where an amendment timestamp is present but the amended optimum is null, the re-quote is missing from the record, the clause cannot be run and POL-RD-10(5) applies, and the tribunal must not derive a substitute figure. POL-RD-10(5) lists 'a POL-RD-05 amendment with amended_optimal_distance_km null' among its mandatory escalation triggers. I cannot issue a final ruling, and under POL-GEN-03 escalation is terminal: no refund to the rider, no payment to the driver, and the disputed 14.90 is held.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT: the amended-route re-quote (amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min for the amended endpoint), or a platform statement that no re-quote exists and the booked 11.0 km optimal is the correct baseline against which to run POL-RD-01.

THE CLAIMS I ACCEPT BUT WHICH DO NOT CHANGE THIS. The driver is right that the trace figure is 5.91 km (EV-GPS-00711, trace_distance_km) against a booked optimal of 11.0 km (EV-TRIP-00711), an excess of −5.09 km / −46.3%, and that on that baseline no POL-RD-01 deviation is established; the rider's excess claim therefore cannot run on the booked baseline either. But the booked optimal is the route to the destination the rider never reached, which is exactly why POL-RD-05 and its escalation govern.

GPS INTEGRITY. I accept the trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: coverage_pct 100.0, 151 fixes at a 10 s interval against an expected 10 s, gaps [] and max_gap_sec 0.0. Neither POL-RD-07's corroboration requirement nor POL-RD-10(3) is engaged. The only impaired artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00711-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no fact and is not a deciding artifact; under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped by the artifacts the ruling rests on, and the deciding fact (the amendment with a null amended optimum) is carried by EV-TRIP-00711 at weight 1.0.

MISSING TRAFFIC ADVISORY. The driver's breakdown explanation cites no advisory identifier and no advisory covers the trip window (EV-ADVIS-00711-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the explanation carries no weight under POL-RD-08). But because no identifier was cited for it, POL-RD-13(1) makes the absent advisory a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, so the advisory is NOT the reason for this escalation.

MONEY AND PASS-THROUGHS. Even apart from the escalation, this is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: EV-FARE-00711 shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 14.90, charged_total 14.90, charged_over_quote 0.00 and pol_rd_11_remedy 0.00, so no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider under POL-RD-11. The POL-RD-09 pass-through audit is likewise empty — no ERP lines, airport surcharge 0.00, waiting_time_fee 0.00, properly_chargeable total 0.00 — so there is no standalone correction and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity finding, and no POL-RD-09(4) referral arises.

DRIVER CONDUCT AND PROFILES. No material deviation arises, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 250, so no POL-RD-06 pattern is established and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral fires. The lifetime counters (prior_deviation_flags) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used for any finding.

THE PRIVATE PAYMENTS. The chat exchanges about private money (EV-CHAT-00711: 'Send 500 first then you go' at 08:27:00 and 'Repair 1800 you pay' at 08:40:20) and the driver's statement that the private payment was 'voluntary' concern money outside the fare ledger, and the rider's filing contests only the 14.90. That is not mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength about the disputed platform fare, so POL-RD-10(7) does not fire.

OUTCOME. The rider's reading that this dispute is confined to the SGD 14.90 platform fare is accepted. The driver's submission that the outcome is NO_ACTION is rejected: POL-RD-10(5) is a mandatory escalation and it supersedes a final money ruling. The 14.90 is held pending the reviewer's examination of the missing amended-route re-quote.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
